summary: S-2 meets C-6. The slice adds src/export.mjs and tests/export.test.mjs, both listed in the S-2 paths, and touches nothing else. exportMarkdown(store) maps each note to '## <title>', a blank line, the body, and a trailing newline, then joins the sections with a newline. That gives one ## section per note in store order with the body below its heading, as C-6 and the change spec requirement 'Export to markdown' require. An empty store returns an empty string. npm test ran 7 tests (2 for export, 5 for notes): 7 pass, 0 fail, exit 0. No secrets, no non-English prose, no block or major findings. One note on the raw body emission. The working tree shows the two files as untracked, so the diff hash covers them and the evidence was read from the working tree.

findings.issue: Bodies are emitted verbatim. A body that contains a line starting with '## ' would look like an extra section to a naive reader of the output. The criterion and spec do not ask for escaping, so this is informational only.
findings.suggestion: Optional: leave as is for v0.2. Revisit if exported markdown is parsed back into notes.

evidence.quote: The library SHALL export the store as markdown with one `## <title>` section per note followed by its body.
exportMarkdown writes one ## section per note in store order
exportMarkdown of an empty store is an empty string
npm test: tests 7, pass 7, fail 0, exit 0

criteria.note:

alpha body
